verdict.rationale: Plausible is an analytics product, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents none. Traffic spike notifications, period comparisons and tracking of referrals from AI tools like ChatGPT are adjacent features, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
